measurement: recipient PDLSC bulk RNA-seq normalized signal

condition_definition.LPS: osteogenic medium with P. gingivalis LPS 5 µg/mL
condition_definition.PDLSC-CM: conditioned medium with corresponding osteogenic supplements
condition_definition.LPS+PDLSC-CM: LPS 5 µg/mL plus conditioned medium with corresponding osteogenic supplements

ratio_orientation: Each named X VS. Y ratio is Y/X in the supplied data; verified against normalized log2 signals.
normalization_as_reported: Bowtie2 alignment; Bedtools counts; quantile normalization using EdgeR; ExDEGA visualization.
filter_as_reported: fold change >=2 and P<.05; source-wide description, no gene-specific P/FDR provided in supplied columns
interpretation: CM is associated with a higher BUB1B RNA summary in the LPS setting. CM alone is below control. This is not a per-cell increase or a BubR1 protein/function result.
limitations: no replicate/sample identifiers or separate replicate columns
RNA harvest time not clearly specified
raw counts are not the reported normalized fold ratio
no BubR1 protein, stability, localization or mitotic function measurement

protein_identity_scope.name: Mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine-protein kinase BUB1 beta
protein_identity_scope.result: No matching entry in supplied detected-protein tables, not a validated protein null

portable_replay.scope: Descriptive arithmetic only; no new significance or protein inference
